source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-1

procedures.title: Body construction: general description
notes: The body is a steel framework (see figure 1 in the manual) combined with fiberglass-reinforced plastic panels, giving more torsional rigidity and beam strength.
Two body styles: convertible (folding top or removable hardtop; either top standard, both optional) and the new coupe with removable roof panels.
Page also carries the section 1B index.

procedures.title: Hood: adjust
steps: Adjust hood position first, then the catches (see figure 2 in the manual).
To move the hood fore or aft, loosen the lower hinge retaining bolts and shift the hood within the slotted holes of the hinge strap.
notes: Hood position relative to the opening and fenders depends on hinge position plus catch and bumper position/adjustment.
